I can't access real-time data, including current weather. To find the most up-to-date weather in Berlin, I recommend checking a reliable weather website or app like:

- [Weather.com (The Weather Channel)](https://weather.com)
- [AccuWeather](https://www.accuweather.com)
- [BBC Weather](https://www.bbc.com/weather)
- Your smartphone's built-in weather app

Let me know if you'd like help interpreting a forecast or understanding weather terms!
